# 3 Common Hair Problems and How OLAPLEX Nº.3PLUS Fixes Them


Healthy hair doesn’t just look good. It’s also strong, resilient, and protected from everyday stress. But common concerns like hair breakage, dry hair, and dull hair can make even the best styles fall flat. Heat styling, coloring, brushing, even environmental exposure all weaken hair over time, often before you can see or feel the damage.


That’s where[Nº.3PLUS Complete Repair Treatment](https://olaplex.com/products/n-3plus-complete-repair-treatment) comes in. This next evolution of the iconic Nº.3 Hair Perfector® is designed to repair past, present, and future damage, working inside and outside the hair strand to deliver stronger, healthier-looking hair in just 3 minutes.


Best of all, it works on all hair types. Let’s break down three of the most common hair problems and how Nº.3PLUS helps fix them.


## What is Nº.3PLUS Complete Repair Treatment?


Nº.3PLUS is a pre-shampoo treatment that repairs and protects hair by rebuilding damaged bonds in just 3 minutes, strengthening hair from the inside out.


### How to Use Nº.3PLUS for Best Results


1. Before shampooing, wet hair and squeeze out excess water.
2. Apply Nº.3PLUS from mid-lengths to ends.
3. Leave on for 3 minutes.
4. Rinse, then shampoo and condition as usual.


Use every 1-3 washes, depending on your level of damage.


## 3 Most Common Hair Problems and How Nº.3PLUS Fixes Them ****


1. Hair Breakage


Hair breakage is one of the most visible signs of compromised hair health. When hair bonds are weakened by heat, chemical services, or mechanical stress, strands lose their structural integrity and break more easily.


How Nº.3PLUS Complete Repair Treatment Helps Reduce Hair Breakage


Nº.3 PLUS is a bond repair treatment that rebuilds all[three types of bonds](https://olaplex.com/blogs/news/what-are-hair-bonds) within the hair strand. Unlike traditional conditioners or masks that coat the surface of the hair, Nº.3PLUS works internally to:


- Strengthen weakened hair strands
- Reduce breakage, with hair becoming 3x stronger instantly
- Improve resilience against future damage, helping build a 75% stronger internal structure over time


By reinforcing the hair’s core and cuticle, Nº.3PLUS delivers true hair breakage repair, not just temporary smoothness.


### 2. Dry Hair


[Dry hair](https://olaplex.com/blogs/news/how-to-manage-dry-brittle-hair-at-home) isn’t just about a lack of moisture. It’s often a sign of internal damage that prevents hair from retaining hydration. This can lead to rough texture, tangles, and increased breakage over time.


How Nº.3PLUS Complete Repair Treatment Helps Repair Dry Hair


Nº.3 PLUS goes beyond traditional conditioners by addressing the root cause of hair dryness. It repairs internal damage that can cause moisture loss while smoothing the cuticle for immediate softness.


Key benefits include:


- Deep damaged hair repair that improves moisture retention
- Noticeably softer hair after one use
- Lightweight hydration using 360° cuticle-to-cortex repair strengthening the hair from the inside out


Used as a pre-shampoo treatment, Nº . 3PLUS preps hair for more effective cleansing and conditioning, helping the dryness improve with continued use and achieving 3x more softness.


### 3. Dull Hair


If your hair looks flat or your color fades quickly, internal damage might be disrupting how light reflects off the hair shaft. This often results in dull-looking hair and reduced color vibrancy.


How Nº.3PLUS Complete Repair Treatment Helps Maintain Color and Shine


By repairing bonds and smoothing the cuticle, Nº.3PLUS improves surface integrity, helping hair look shinier and healthier while supporting color longevity. ****


It helps by:


- Strengthening hair to reduce[porosity](https://olaplex.com/blogs/news/low-vs-high-porosity-hair-and-how-to-test-it)
- Supporting vibrant, salon-fresh color
- Being color-safe


Healthier hair holds onto color better, making Nº.3PLUS an essential step in any color-care routine.


## Advice for Different Hair Types and Textures


Nº.3PLUS Complete Repair Treatment is designed for all hair types, whether your hair is straight, wavy, curly or coily, chemically treated, or prone to breakage.


Fine Hair


- Apply smaller amount, focusing on mid-lengths to ends
- Follow up with[Nº.4FINE Bond Maintenance® Shampoo](https://olaplex.com/collections/wash-us/products/n-4fine-bond-maintenance-shampoo-us) and[Nº.5FINE Bond Maintenance® Conditioner](https://olaplex.com/collections/wash-us/products/n-5fine-bond-maintenance-conditioner-us) for weightless hydration and volume


Curly or Coily Hair


- Apply generously to enhance softness, elasticity, and curl definition
- Pair with[Nº.6 Bond Smoother®](https://olaplex.com/products/olaplex-n-6-bond-smoother-us/) and[OLAPLEX Nº.7 Bonding Oil™](https://olaplex.com/blogs/news/%20https://olaplex.com/products/olaplex-n-7-bonding-oil-us) for added definition and shine


Thick or Coarse Hair


- Section hair for even distribution
- Use the[Rich Hydration Mask](https://olaplex.com/products/rich-hydration-mask-us/) weekly in place of conditioner for added strength and shine


Highly Damaged Hair


- Use 2-3 times per week
- Follow up with[Nº.4 Bond Maintenance® Shampoo](https://olaplex.com/products/olaplex-n-4-bond-maintenance-shampoo-us) and[Nº.5 Bond Maintenance® Conditioner](https://olaplex.com/products/olaplex-n-5-bond-maintenance-conditioner-us) to support softness and manageability

## Frequently Asked Questions


### Do I need to use Nº.0 Intensive Bond Building Treatment with Nº.3PLUS Complete Repair Treatment?


No, you don’t need to use[Nº.0 Intensive Bond Building Treatment](https://olaplex.com/products/olaplex-n-0-intensive-bond-building-treatment-us/) with Nº.3PLUS. Nº.0 was designed to be used alongside the original Nº.3 Hair Perfector® for an extra boost. However, Nº.3PLUS is a next-generation formula and already delivers that enhanced performance on its own—so Nº.0 is not required.


### How is Nº.3PLUS Complete Repair Treatment different from conditioner or a hair mask?


While conditioners and masks primarily smooth and hydrate the surface of the hair, Nº.3PLUS works inside the hair to repair damage at its source. Conditioners and masks support softness and manageability, while Nº.3PLUS strengthens the hair structure so it can better retain moisture, shine, and color.
